title: Visual Narrative & Content Authoring Workbench
objective: Provide visual graph/object authoring over completed CNI structured content contracts for dialogue, quest, trigger, reusable-content, condition/action, dependency, validation, localization/VO-context, preview/playtest and deterministic-export preparation without creating a parallel narrative runtime or replacing CNI owner authority.

scope.purpose: Provide a first-class visual narrative/content authoring and inspection workbench over CNI-governed structured content rather than requiring direct structured-file editing or creating a parallel narrative runtime.
scope.completion_gate: Representative CNI-governed structured content can be deterministically authored, inspected, validated, previewed and exported through an inspectable workbench projection while CNI remains authoritative for content/narrative runtime and invalid owner/reference/action/dependency states fail closed.

selection_boundaries: Owner Continue on 2026-09-16 governed-started PCA-10; implementation authority is limited to work/pca-10-visual-narrative-content-authoring-workbench.
PCA-01..09 remain completed foundations and must be composed rather than reimplemented or weakened.

CNI retains content/narrative runtime/interoperability authority; PCA-10 may prepare authoring documents, graph/object projections, validation findings, preview/playtest plans and deterministic exports only.
Dialogue, quest, trigger, reusable-content, condition/action and dependency truth must resolve against existing CNI owner contracts; PCA-10 creates no parallel narrative ledger or runtime.
Localization and VO context are metadata/projection preparation only; DWC/AAI/PCA-08 and later localization completion authorities are not replaced.
Preview/playtest preparation authorizes no canonical mutation, live Action/Event dispatch, provider/network execution, publication or release.
PCA-11+, MCS, MCCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
next_action: Load only PCA-02 plus direct CNI-05/CNI-08 and exact dialogue/quest/trigger/action/dependency owner seams needed by the acceptance contract; establish causal PCA-10 RED, then implement the minimum deterministic visual authoring-workbench preparation contract.
